question: Who can become a knower that purifies the land regardless of birth, age, or residence?
premises: A person may be last-born or twice-born, child, old, or youth.
A person may live at the border of the land.
Whoever among them is a knower becomes a purifier of the land.
inference: Knowledge, not birth, age, or location, makes a person a purifier of the land.
uncertainties: The scope of 'land' (deśa) could mean a region or the whole country.
plain_english: Whether last-born or twice-born, child, old, or young, even a border-dweller who is a knower becomes a purifier of the land.
